meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 gtars 来处理基因区间数据:检测重叠、生成覆盖度轨道、做机器学习分词,以及处理参考序列和片段文件。支持 Python 与命令行。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 BED 文件、找基因区间重叠、生成覆盖度轨道等基因组分析时触发。

say.text: 用 gtars 找出这两份 BED 的重叠区间
say.note: 会构建 IGD 索引并输出重叠区域。

say.text: 把 fragments.bed 生成 BigWig 覆盖度轨道
say.note: 会用 uniwig 模块生成轨道文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use gtars to analyze genomic intervals: detect overlaps, generate coverage tracks, tokenize for ML, and process reference sequences and fragment files. Supports Python and CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to process BED files, find genomic interval overlaps, generate coverage tracks, or other genomic analyses.

say_en.text: Use gtars to find overlaps between these two BED files
say_en.note: Builds an IGD index and outputs overlapping regions.

say_en.text: Generate a BigWig coverage track from fragments.bed
say_en.note: Uses the uniwig module to create the track file.
Tokenizes the sequence for machine learning.
